verdict.rationale: ADK documents a Swagger UI interactive reference at /docs on the Python and TypeScript API servers, where users can send live 'Try it out' requests, and it publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 'ADK REST API Reference' that the docs site also renders in Swagger UI. Runnable execution only targets the user's own locally run `adk api_server`, there is no hosted sandbox, and the Go server has no /docs endpoint. Missing for 10: hosted runnable examples without self-hosting a local server, /docs parity for the Go (and other) API servers, independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: Swagger UI interactive documentation is served at `/docs` by the Python and TypeScript ADK API servers only
to send live requests to your running agents.
The docs site additionally hosts a Swagger UI browsing the published spec.
The Go API server exposes no /docs endpoint, and live execution targets the user's own local server.
ADK publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 document
